defect.description: Input_args given as ordinary ffmpeg arguments in a string rather than a preset name (for example '-rtsp_transport tcp') are concatenated as a str onto the argument list: get_ffmpeg_arg_list(...) + '-rtsp_transport tcp' raises TypeError (can only concatenate list to list), so audio detection fails to start; the fallbacks need get_ffmpeg_arg_list(...) like the global args.

review_items: TypeError when input_args is a plain ffmpeg-arg string: or-fallback concatenates str onto list (lines 15-20)
IndexError when no input has audio role (pre-existing)
Hardcoded detect_fps=1 for audio stream; add comment
votes.evidence_quote: when `parse_preset_input(ffmpeg_input.input_args, 1)` returns `None` (not a preset name), line 17's `or ffmpeg_input.input_args` yields the raw string, and `list + str` on line 15 raises `TypeError: can only concatenate list (not "str")`.
votes.justification: The review reports the known defect: a plain string of ffmpeg arguments is concatenated onto a list and raises TypeError. It places this in get_ffmpeg_command in src/audio.py and proposes the same fix, wrapping the fallback in get_ffmpeg_arg_list.
